blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Light rains and overcast skies are expected in parts of the country on Thursday, Nov. 5, due to the persistence of the northeast monsoon or “amihan” and the easterlies, according to the state weather bureau. In its 4 p.m. weather advisory, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported that the “amihan” may continue to bring cloudy skies with light rains over Batanes and Babuyan Islands. “Dito sa may Northern Luzon, andyan pa rin ang may kalamigang northeast monsoon or hanging amihan na siyang nagdadala na ng cloudy skies with some light rains dito sa may […]...
